html:
G'oya

Har bir yozuvni shu mahsulotning oldingi yozuvi bilan solishtirish kerak. LAG(price) oldingi narxni yoniga qo'yadi, PARTITION BY product_id esa "oldingi" ni faqat shu mahsulot tarixidan oladi. Qolgani filtr: yangi narx eskisidan katta.

Yechim

SELECT product_id, day, old_price, new_price
FROM (
  SELECT product_id, day, price AS new_price,
         LAG(price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY day) AS old_price
  FROM price_history
) t
WHERE new_price > old_price

LAG ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri WHERE ga yozib bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun u ichki so'rovda hisoblanadi. Mahsulotning birinchi yozuvida old_price NULL, new_price > NULL esa rost bo'lmaydi. Bu qator o'zi tushib qoladi, alohida tekshirish shart emas.

Tuzoqlar

Oldingi yozuvni day - 1 orqali qidirish. Namunada 2-mahsulot narxi 1-, 3- va 5-kunlarda yozilgan. 5-kunda narx 50 dan 70 ga oshgan, lekin 4-kun yozuvi yo'q va bu oshish natijaga kirmaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT p.product_id, p.day, q.price AS old_price, p.price AS new_price
FROM price_history p
JOIN price_history q ON q.product_id = p.product_id AND q.day = p.day - 1
WHERE p.price > q.price

>= yozilsa, narx o'zgarmagan kunlar ham chiqadi: 2-mahsulotning 3-kuni (50 dan 50 ga). PARTITION BY siz esa mahsulotning birinchi narxi oldingi mahsulotning oxirgi narxi bilan solishtiriladi.
